name: 火山方舟
desc: Model platform covering inference, evaluation and fine-tuning.
desc_zh: 覆盖推理、评测与精调的大模型平台
solves: Adopting a model is the easy part. Serving it, scaling it and gating who may call it is the part that takes a team.
solves_zh: 用上模型只是第一步。推理、扩容和调用权限控制，才是真正要花人力的部分。
best_for: Calling models in production without standing up your own inference stack.
best_for_zh: 要在生产环境稳定调用大模型，又不想自己搭一套推理服务。
